reference.description: re-computes the mutual information with sklearn.metrics.mutual_info_score on the identical equal-width bin labels (bit-exact), and reports a shuffled-surrogate control quantifying the histogram estimator's finite-sample bias; reports the op MI, the sklearn agreement, the shuffled-control MI, the real/shuffled ratio, the sample count, and the bin count
